# AI Chief of Staff

Free · Open source

An AI that remembers your business. It knows your priorities, projects and people, and opens every session with a brief on where things stand.

At a glance

-   8 commands
-   Memory kept in plain files on your computer
-   Set up in one conversation
-   Works in the Claude desktop app and Claude Code
-   MIT license

## Most AI forgets you the moment you close the tab.

Every chat starts from zero. Last week's decision, last quarter's context and the person you met on Tuesday are all gone. You spend the first ten minutes of every session explaining your business to a tool that should already know it.

## Start. Work. Save.

1.  01
    
    ### Start
    
    Type `/start`. It reads its memory and briefs you on what moved, what's due and what needs your call.
    
2.  02
    
    ### Work
    
    Draft, decide, prepare. It already has the context, so you skip the catch-up.
    
3.  03
    
    ### Save
    
    Type `/save`. It writes down what changed: decisions, priorities, new people. Tomorrow picks up where today ended.
    

Once a week, `/review` steps back: what moved, what stalled, and the one priority for the week ahead.

## Eight commands. You'll learn them by using them.

/onboard

First-time setup. You name your chief of staff, then brief it on your role, business, priorities and people.

/start

Opens each session with a brief.

/save

Writes what changed back to memory.

/review

Weekly review: patterns, stalls and next week's priority.

/capture

Hand it a link or document. It files what matters to you.

/sync

Absorbs everything you've dropped in since last time.

/query

Answers from your own history, not the open internet.

/lint

Checks its own memory for anything stale or contradictory.

-   Your memory is a folder of plain text files. Open it in any editor or in Obsidian.
-   No database and no account with us. Take everything with you any time.
-   You need a Claude plan with the desktop app or Claude Code.

> “We've had noticeable productivity gains and better communication since our team started using our Claude assistant.”

Reza Varzidehkar, CEO, OVOU
